pcs.pc_description: check the readiness of equipment and calibration of instruments used at LNG terminal as per SOP
patrol units ensure security and safety
observe automatic warning signals and alarm
check for leaks and faulty engines, compressors, pipeline, equipment, valves, pumps, etc.

modules.module_title: Testing and identification of fault in LNG terminal

pcs.pc_description: inspect, and maintain pipeline, equipment and systems installed at terminal such as cryogenic plants, hydrocarbon fractionation units, process controls and measurement unit, LNG facilities, engines and compressors, pumps, pump stations, pressure relief systems, instrument air systems, dehydrators, fuel systems, treating, emergency shutdown systems, reciprocating compressors, gas fired heaters, process pumps, amine treating systems, inlet gas receivers and NGL storage and transfer facilities
inspect machines or equipment for hazards, operating efficiency, malfunctions, wear, or leaks
identify the type of fault
report identified fault to the supervisor/manager
coordinate with LNG terminal supervisor for repair of faulty engines, compressors, pipeline, equipment, valves, pumps, etc.

modules.module_title: Repair and maintenance at LNG terminal

pcs.pc_description: carryout preventive and breakdown maintenance as per maintenance manual
remove the faulty part from the system
carry out adjustment in machine controls to regulate conditions such as material flow, temperature, pressure, etc.
apply appropriate solution for maintenance/repair on faulty instrument control system/electrical system/ mechanical system
check all the inspection points as per maintenance/repair SOP
carry out visual inspection of the repaired instrument or equipment after maintenance/repair
carry out inspection using calibration instruments and tools
utilize the material required during repair and maintenance activity efficiently to minimize the waste and store the unused or reusable material
clean the site and remove the maintenance /repair signages from the unit of the LNG terminal
